# Where to save generated files

Any deliverable you generate — PDF, HTML, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, decks, dossiers, reports —
goes in `~/ClaudeDocs/`, **not** the home directory, Desktop, or Downloads.

`~/ClaudeDocs` is a symlink into iCloud, so files written there sync to Ranjith's other
Mac automatically and get versioned in the git backup. A file saved anywhere else exists
on one machine only.

Use the existing subfolder when one fits, or create a new one named for the project:

- `~/ClaudeDocs/inc42/` — INC42 PRDs, knowledge repo, strategy docs
- `~/ClaudeDocs/nexloid/` — Nexloid dossier, pricing, ad copy
- `~/ClaudeDocs/personal/` — health, fitness, personal specs
- `~/ClaudeDocs/workshops/` — session decks and teaching material

Exceptions — do NOT put these in `~/ClaudeDocs`:

- Throwaway scratch files. Those belong in the session scratchpad directory.
- Files that belong inside a git repo you are working in. Save them in the repo.
- Financial or identity documents (invoices, Aadhaar, bank statements, payslips).
  Leave them where they are; do not copy them into iCloud.

Tell Ranjith the path you saved to.
